label: Diagram 3.3
caption: Diagram 3.3 Flat with restricted travel distance from furthest point to entrance
description:
The drawing, titled "Diagram 3.3 Flat with restricted travel distance from furthest point to entrance," shows two plan views of flat layouts arranged side by side within a bordered box, with the note "See para 3.18" at the top left.

The left plan is a rectangular block of rooms. The top-left interior space is labelled "Kitchen area" and contains a counter or sink symbol; the top-right space is labelled "Bath" and shows a door and bath. Two green diagonal lines, each marked "9m max.", run from the door at the bottom edge, labelled "Flat entrance," up to the top-left and top-right corners of the plan. A leader line from the label "Distance not restricted" points to the top edge of the plan.

The right plan is another rectangular flat divided into several rooms, the top-left room labelled "Kitchen". Green lines marked "9m max." run from the doorway at the bottom, labelled "Flat entrance," to the top-left and top-right corners of the plan, and also upwards along the central passage from the same entrance point.
